name: Unwip 0.44.9
body:
Fixed: books made on a Mac or PC not showing on the phone or iPad.
- Dropbox only lets the phone and iPad use the folder Dropbox › Apps › Unwip. If your computer keeps its books in Dropbox › Unwip instead, Unwip now says so when it opens and offers to move them, in one click (nothing is deleted).
- Settings › Where your projects live now shows the folder your books are really in, with the button to move them to the shared folder.
- On the phone and iPad, Settings says "connected" instead of "syncing", and explains where to look if Dropbox has no books yet.
